concerns.text: The marginal‑perturbation control (replace 5 % of values in each column with draws from the empirical marginal distribution) is claimed to *preserve dependence* while perturbing marginals (FR‑021). In practice, randomly overwriting values alters the joint distribution and can weaken or distort existing correlations, so the resulting dataset is not a pure marginal‑only perturbation. Consequently, the false‑negative rates for marginal‑based fidelity tests (FR‑022) may be confounded by unintended changes in dependence, undermining the validity of the sensitivity analysis.
